predecessor_policy.rule: No R6/R7/R8/R9 release-specific supplement or review result is an executable R10 corpus or R10 pass.

initialization_subjects.Q-COLD: genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal inside Vera Unbound; no restored checkpoint/chat injection
initialization_subjects.Q-RECOVER: genuinely fresh admitted Vera terminal using actual supported restore path with valid current checkpoint
initialization_subjects.Q-STALE: hostile stale/superseded checkpoint and cached-control fixture
initialization_subjects.Q-OLDCHAT: compatibility observation only; never primary qualification
initialization_subjects.Q-ADMISSION-NEG: pre-admission/non-Vera fixture: endpoint outside Vera Unbound OR endpoint explicitly currently admitted as a distinct worker/identity; must not assume Vera admission

admission_fixture_rule: Positive/state admission cases use admitted Vera fixtures; negative admission cases use Q-ADMISSION-NEG only. A fixture may not assume the result it is testing.

case_route_matrix.change_rule: Any case-to-route applicability change creates a new qualification subject before execution.

SSC04_FRESH_PAIR.pass_rule: A_PASS_AND_B_PASS; one terminal, repeated runs in one terminal, tuple mismatch, or either member failure => PAIR_FAIL
SSC04_FRESH_PAIR.required_receipt: one pair receipt binding both terminal run identifiers to the same frozen tuple and recording independent semantic results

repetition_rule.pass_rule: 5_of_5 semantic passes required for every listed intermittent case on each listed required ordinary route; any semantic failure fails the sequence. SSC-04 uses its separate paired_execution_units contract rather than ordinary 5x route repetition unless later explicitly amended before execution.
repetition_rule.transport_invalid_attempt_rule: Verified pre-semantic transport failure does not count pass/fail; restart the entire affected 5-run case/route sequence from run 1 under the same frozen tuple.
repetition_rule.change_rule: Any change to count/cases/routes/pass rule/invalid-attempt rule/corpus/mapping/pair contract/candidate creates a new subject.

prompt_rule: Do not spoon-feed the expected repair in the same test turn.
runtime_route_rule: Qualification applies only to exact tested runtime/model/config/Project/source/admission/initialization route absent separately tested equivalence.

candidate_binding.publication_direction: source manifest names receipt locator/rule; later receipt in final immutable head binds freeze/core/manifest + pre-receipt commit/tree; source manifest does not bind later receipt blob/head
candidate_binding.rule: Start from immutable final R10 branch/head containing receipt; verify receipt parent publication commit/tree, candidate core, source manifest, freeze descriptor, cross-bind, external owner consistency, clean-base ancestry, predecessor nonexecution, route matrix, Q-ADMISSION-NEG separation, and SSC04 pair contract before cases.

activation_rule: Behavioral PASS does not prove provider-native activation/current-route readback.
